name: image-peek
description: Draws the images the agent reads (Read on png/jpg/gif/webp, image blocks in tool results) as pictures under their tool row in the transcript.

maxColumns.title: Max width (columns)
maxColumns.description: Widest a preview is drawn, in terminal columns; it is also kept 6 columns inside the transcript.

maxRows.title: Max height (rows)
maxRows.description: Tallest a preview is drawn, in terminal rows.

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: cells fits each cell's glyph and two colours to the picture (block elements, eighths, quadrants, wedges) and works in any truecolor terminal, tmux included. half is the old one: half blocks, two pixels a cell. image uses the kitty graphics protocol (kitty, Ghostty, outside tmux) for real pixels.

glyphs.title: Glyphs (cells renderer)
glyphs.description: wedges adds the Powerline diagonal wedges (U+E0B8-E0BE) for smooth diagonal edges; needs a Nerd Font. blocks uses Block Elements only, for any font.
